svg.title: Time from a DynamoDB write to the denied request
svg.desc: Risk raised: median 73.4 ms, p95 83.4; Relationship revoked: median 68.8 ms, p95 83.1; KYC downgraded: median 67.4 ms, p95 86; Role removed: median 68.2 ms, p95 82.7; Offboarded: median 66.1 ms, p95 86.1; Signed out: median 66.7 ms, p95 72.1
svg.text: Time from a DynamoDB write to the denied request
Same access token throughout. Each dot is one revocation; the first request after the write is the one measured.
ms (dots beyond 150 ms are drawn at the edge)
Write-to-deny = write start until the DENY response arrives (one write + one full request). Source:
